{{Top}}
'''Baradium nitrate''' was a form of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] that, while in a liquid form, was less prone to accidental detonation. During the [[New Sith Wars]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] refined the nitrate in a factory on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] stole some baradium nitrate from the factory, and later used it to destroy the [[Death Spiral]], a massive siege tower, at the [[Battle of Gazzari]].
